notes: §2002:14.8.34.1 lets NEXT SENTENCE stand as the body of a SEARCH WHEN or AT END phrase; §2002:G.1 item 3 lists the phrase in the SEARCH statement as archaic and §2002:3.1.10 requires an optional compile-time archaic-element warning. The construct edge next-sentence-archaic-2002 (obsoleteIn 2002, was 2023: kb/Work PB5723) gives COBOL0903 at the phrase at --std 2002, 2014 and 2023, silent at 85. Run at --std 2002 the SEARCH case compiles, warns once and prints its output.
